scope: Rules-based V2 critic for hero fire orb sweep reads.

detection_rules: HeroFireSweep emitter is missing or under-authored.
Hero sweep is not visually distinct from secondary support.
hero_sweep_missing.escalation_rule: Two consecutive hero-layer failures force a rebuild.

detection_rules: HeroFireSweep does not establish a readable outer-zone to core motion path.
no_outside_to_core_read.escalation_rule: Two consecutive failures force a rebuild.

detection_rules: Hero fire motion reads as a directional plume or jet rather than an orb sweep.
smoke_plume_silhouette.escalation_rule: Reduce plume motion immediately; rebuild after repeated failure.

detection_rules: Secondary or support layers close into a ring shell around the orb.
orbit_ring_shell.escalation_rule: Retune support distribution before touching the hero sweep.

detection_rules: HeroFireSweep is rendered with thin ribbon-first bodies instead of thick flame streaks.
thin_wireframe_ribbons.escalation_rule: Two consecutive hits force a hero rebuild.

detection_rules: SecondaryFireFilaments compete with HeroFireSweep for dominance.
secondary_overwhelms_hero.escalation_rule: Reduce secondary support before modifying the hero layer.

detection_rules: Hero streak material reads as graphic linework rather than broad flame mass.
linework_not_flame_body.escalation_rule: Simplify flame body before adding noise or bloom.

detection_rules: BindGlow reads as a flat halo shell rather than a compact binding glow.
flat_halo_shell.escalation_rule: Fix the core bind before polishing secondary layers.
